title: Witness sketches of object shape phases (First–Fourth), Columbus sighting, 2 Aug 48
description: Typed account of a round object about 20 to 30 ft in diameter seen on 2 Aug 48 moving south over the center of Columbus, with a grey-black perimeter and transparent center, that changed shape from a parallelogram side view to circular. Below an agent's note that the witness drew the sketches, four outline drawings labeled "First" (a thin bar), "Second", "Third" and "Fourth" (progressively rounder ovals). Caption: "The above drawings constitute four positions of one phase. The object passed thru three of these phases during the 15 minute period."
